description: Local LLM runtime. The hosted variant at ollama.com/turbo serves API keys for paid inference; the self-hosted server at `localhost:11434` (or wherever you run it) accepts an optional bearer token via `OLLAMA_API_KEY` when the operator pins one. The framework only stores the value — the key shape is provider-defined free-form because self-hosted operators set their own.

variants.description: Bearer token for hosted Ollama Turbo or a self-hosted server protected by `OLLAMA_API_KEY`. The hosted shape is `ollama-...` (provider docs are sparse on the exact length); self-hosted operators pick whatever string they like, so the catalog accepts any non-empty value.
variants.format_hint: free-form bearer token (provider does not pin a shape; self-hosted operators choose their own)

steps: For hosted Ollama Turbo: open https://ollama.com/settings/keys, sign in, click Create API key, copy the value.
For self-hosted: pick any opaque string (e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`) and set it on the server via `OLLAMA_API_KEY=<value>`. The same value goes here in devboy.
retrieval.notes: Hosted Turbo billing follows the Ollama account; self-hosted has no billing surface. Self-hosted servers behind a network firewall can run with no key at all — devboy only stores a value if the user provides one.

rotation.notes: Hosted Turbo: delete the old key and Create a new one on the keys page — they can coexist briefly, so stage the new value first. Self-hosted: there is exactly ONE OLLAMA_API_KEY per server, so rotation is a hard cutover — generate a new opaque value, set it on the server, restart the daemon, then update devboy. The server accepts only the current value, so consumers 401 during the restart window.
